title: Quantum Computing & Sensing
businessQuestion: What computational problems achieve genuine quantum utility before full error correction?
investorQuestion: Which qubit modality and cryogenic stack offers the lowest cost per logical qubit?
overview: Quantum records are mostly research and proof of concept, with error correction and hardware modalities dominating. Commercial entries concentrate in sensing and post-quantum cryptography — nearer-term businesses with current buyers — rather than fault-tolerant computing. Read the sector as several distinct markets sharing a vocabulary.
